title: Microsoft releases february 2020 security updates
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-279.021220: TT-CSIRT ADVISORY- MICROSOFT RELEASES FEBRUARY 2020 SECURITY UPDATES
leadParagraph: Microsoft has released security updates to address multiple vulnerabilities in their software. An attacker could exploit some of these vulnerabilities to take control of an affected system.
contentHtml:
Microsoft has released security updates to address multiple vulnerabilities in their software. An attacker could exploit some of these vulnerabilities to take control of an affected system.

TT-CSIRT encourages users and administrators to review Microsoft’s February 2020 Security Update Summary and Deployment Information and apply the necessary updates.

  • https://portal.msrc.microsoft.com/en-us/security-guidance/releasenotedetail/2020-Feb
  • https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/help/20200211/security-update-deployment-information-february-11-2020
